why: Hysteresis is the half of the fix aimed at the largest measured bucket: 40.6% of reversals under a shooting player (48.2% on arena3) were `bullet->bullet`, dangerAvoidMove's dodge perpendicular swapping sides as the tank crossed the shell's axis -- two equally good dodges 180 degrees apart. Without the cone the AI re-adopts the flipped candidate at every window expiry. Killed by the pair of cone tests, which assert both that an inside-cone candidate is refused AND that an outside-cone one is adopted.
killedBy: commitMove does not let an expiring span adopt the flipped perpendicular either
commitMove keeps the held vector when an expiring span offers a near-equivalent candidate
